prompt_text:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the beer can in <Picture 1>: a 500 ml aluminum beer can with a blue top and lid, a silver-white metallic body, small blue letters "BRAVE THE WORLD" near the top, large bold blue letters "SUPER DRY" across the middle and a red label block reading "SUPER DRY DRAFT BEER".

summary:
[reference generation] A product hero shot of a single <Subject 1> standing centered and front-facing on a glossy deep-blue surface while a soft highlight moves across the metal.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - the can's proportions, blue top, silver-white body, small "BRAVE THE WORLD" text, large bold blue "SUPER DRY" lettering and red "SUPER DRY DRAFT BEER" block are retained exactly.

detailed_description:
The target video is a photorealistic premium beer commercial product shot with controlled studio lighting and a rich deep-blue palette, with crisp silver highlights.
[Shot 1] A single <Subject 1> stands upright in the exact center of the frame on a glossy deep-blue surface that mirrors its base and lower label in a soft reflection. The background is a rich, smooth blue that darkens toward the edges, crossed by three restrained, thin geometric beams of soft white-blue light that slant diagonally behind the can and fade out at the top of the frame. The can faces the camera squarely with its full label visible: the blue top and lid, the silver-white metallic body, small blue letters "BRAVE THE WORLD" near the top, large bold blue letters "SUPER DRY" across the middle and the red block "SUPER DRY DRAFT BEER" below. Fine condensation droplets cover the cold metal and sparkle where the light touches them. A soft vertical highlight moves slowly across the aluminum from the left edge to the right edge, revealing the curve of the can, while the lettering stays perfectly sharp and readable. The can remains stationary and front-facing throughout; it does not rotate, tilt or change shape, and nothing else appears in the frame. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed across the whole shot, so the can grows slightly larger, and ends on a clean, stable, centered product frame. There is no other text, slogan, logo, subtitle or graphic anywhere in the frame.

overall_soundscape: Near silence with a faint, cool studio air tone and a very soft fizz from the condensation.

non_diegetic_music: Ambient electronic music at a slow tempo: sustained synth pads and a soft low pulse that stop together on a final sustained chord, which fades out at the end.
